g.text: Every window that still holds i also holds j, so drop i as j arrives

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

g.text: i < j and a[i] <= a[j]. Windows only move right — that is the whole proof.
